summary.documentSeriesTitle: Pay Order to Nauvoo City Treasurer for Stephen Markham, 3 September 1843
summary.clearText:
Henry G. Sherwood handwriting begins.

I hereby certify that
Stephen Markham

9 Feb. 1800–10 Mar. 1878. Carpenter, farmer, stock raiser. Born at Rush (later Avon), Ontario Co., New York. Son of David Markham and Dinah Merry. Moved to Mentor, Geauga Co., Ohio, 1809. Moved to Unionville, Geauga Co., 1810. Married Hannah Hogaboom, before...

View Full Bio
1

JS issued this pay order on 3 September 1843. The transaction was recorded in the Nauvoo City Treasury Ledger on 13 December 1843. (Nauvoo City Treasury Ledger, 101.)

assisted in moving Mr Dayly in Case of Small pox— thought to be worth $1—.
3 Sept 1843— Charged to the city of
Nauvoo

Principal gathering place for Saints following expulsion from Missouri. Beginning in 1839, Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints purchased lands in earlier settlement of Commerce and planned settlement of Commerce City, as well as surrounding areas....

Constable
